name: Jarvis
postCreateCommand: pip install --user -e '.[all]' && jarvis bootstrap --sample 30 && jarvis deposit 25000

postAttachCommand.hello:
echo '
  Jarvis is ready.

    jarvis            the full thing (no window here -- runs in this terminal)
    jarvis brief      pre-market briefing
    jarvis daytrade   intraday setups
    jarvis review     coaching on your trades

  Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as a Codespaces secret to give him a mind.
'
